item.title: FPGA: Test Pattern Generator pipeline using Vivado 2025.2
item.author: Jack Bonnell
item.description: This week I have been working on a Test Pattern Generator to VDMA project for the Ultra96-V2. Overview I am currently running this project on the 2025.2 Xilinx toolchain. I’ve been looking at setting up a video pipeline in Vivado and PetaLinux. Due to the lack of camera connectivity I currently possess, I decided I would try and implement the test pattern generator IP. The idea is to, in the future, replace the TPG with a MIPI block to allow for camera connectivity.
